workload_trace_interpretation: Both arms share identical run_id, box indexes, ID offsets, users per shard, native binary, ramp/measurement/tail, think scale and article universe. Pinned run.go derives each shard PCG seed from FNV64a(run_id/box); VU PCG uses that seed plus global user ID. This proves matching generator seed inputs, not an identical request-by-request execution trace. Pinned VU code performs request/page work before timed thinking, so response-dependent schedules and finite-window completion counts can differ. Only aggregate page/session/endpoint counts and per-second summaries are recorded; no full request sequence equality is claimed.
CPU_formula: target cgroup CPU seconds interpolated at the exact full60second wall window boundaries *1000/(measured count-measured errors). This sampled estimate combines app+PostgreSQL and target monitoring overhead, excluding the separate external client. Live-PID PostgreSQL component estimates are withheld where population/counter changes make them invalid.
